en.title: Global Macro — Inflation overturns the oil relief rally as US and Brazilian policy stay restrictive
en.deck: The October US CPI surprise reprices global rates as Brazil's Copom warns of persistent risks and EIA distinguishes historical oil shock from recent quotes.
en.regime: Sticky US inflation and Brazilian inflation expectations require restrictive monetary policy despite prospective energy relief; global capital costs and FX remain exposed.
en.key_risk: Official October 2026 12-month CPI unavailable; do not invent y/y or confuse monthly CPI with annual EIA Brent forecasts and financial close prices.
watch: Fed December pricing and upcoming speeches
Oil delivered prices and maritime security
en.search_text: 11 November 2026 Global Macro: October US consumer inflation surprise, Fed rates and Treasury repricing, Brazil Copom minutes, Ibovespa, EIA energy outlook, China global trade.

pt-BR.title: Global Macro — Inflação americana reverte o alívio dos mercados e restringe a política monetária mundial
pt-BR.deck: Surpresa no CPI americano eleva os juros globais; ata do Copom mantém alerta sobre preços e novo cenário da EIA diferencia petróleo recente do choque acumulado.
pt-BR.regime: Persistência inflacionária americana e expectativas brasileiras exigem política restritiva apesar do possível alívio energético, com impactos cambiais e de crédito mundial.
pt-BR.key_risk: A inflação anual oficial americana de outubro não foi calculada; não confundir CPI mensal, projeção anual de petróleo e fechamento financeiro.
pt-BR.search_text: Global Macro 11 de novembro 2026: inflação americana acima do previsto, títulos EUA, ata Copom, Ibovespa, EIA petróleo e comércio da China.

producer_checks.information_cutoff: 11 Nov 2026 00:35 BRT (03:35 UTC); US and Brazil 10 Nov completed closes; US CPI, BCB Copom minutes and EIA November STEO published Nov10, Brazil IPCA due Nov12.
producer_checks.novelty: Break from Nov10 prior edition: now-published US CPI +0.4 vs forecast +0.3, core +0.3 vs forecast +0.2; BLS missing 2025 baseline for Oct y/y, Treasury 2y+17bps/10y+10bps, Copom minutes BCB projections, EIA Nov10 dated outlook and B3 10 Nov negative close.
producer_checks.bilingual_parity: EN/PT 9 analytical sections, 3 numeric visual datasets identical, one table, one causal flow and one six-region map per language, same 20 original source URLs.
producer_checks.editorial_status: Full bilingual research staged; pending to be SHA-pinned by separate QA stage.
producer_checks.source_check: 20 source URLs on >10 hosts, BLS/Treasury/BCB/B3/EIA primary data with Reuters/AP and official European-China institutions; all temporal vintages and limitations explicitly stated.

contrary_evidence: Monthly CPI is below September even though above consensus and core remains elevated; year-on-year official October missing due absent 2025 base.
US equities remain positive for the week despite Nov10 losses, preventing extrapolation of single session.
Lower daily crude quotations coexist with EIA October average and higher annual projections due different vintages and windows.
Brazil's stronger dollar provides some exporter benefit while increasing local currency costs of imports and external liabilities.
China nominal export strength coexists with PMI below 50.
limitations: No official October 2026 annual US CPI where October 2025 baseline missing.
US yields daily par values differ from intraday Reuters benchmark trade snapshots.
EIA forecast finalised Nov5 released Nov10; no representation as realised forward price.
Brazil IPCA October scheduled Nov12, not observed.
EN/PT research prepared and assistant-led QA reviewed, not independent human approval.
Full production deployment separate from GitHub commit and depends on configured GitHub Actions credentials.
